integrity: The proof uses the published nonequivariant shellability and sphere-count theorem as a stated input, and derives the rotation representation by an explicit combinatorial Alexander-dual fixed-simplex calculation; its limitations and computations are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Only \(p\ge2\) and \(n\ge6p-3\) for the ordinary three-cut complex are proved. The result is a rational representation of the cyclic rotation subgroup, not an integral classification, a reflection character, or an equivariant homotopy splitting. Finite verification is corroborative only.
title: Rational cyclic homology representations of three-cut complexes of cycle powers
